manifest.title: Meep array-slice regression reference
manifest.description: Schema and packaging fixture around a bundled Meep regression HDF5 file. It is not a physical SCYTHE optical dataset and has no geospatial registration.

authority.executionEnvironment: Not executed in this Codespace; existing Meep regression reference wrapped for contract testing only.

spatialReference.axes: Meep two-dimensional x-y cell; component data order documented by array-slice-ll.cpp
spatialReference.originDescription: Centered Meep simulation cell; no physical scale or Earth registration declared.

optical.materialModel: Synthetic dielectric waveguide regression geometry with epsilon=13
optical.boundaryConditions: PML thickness 1 solver unit; exact setup is the hashed input source.

quantity.name: Meep regression field slices
quantity.definition: HDF5 datasets hz.r and hz.i contain a 126-sample complex Hz slice; sy contains a 126 by 38 Poynting-component slice.

uncertainty.description: Bundled regression values have no physical uncertainty or convergence study attached.

lodPolicy.description: Regression fixture is consumed at native resolution only.
